_about: Golden dataset for the Michelangelo Support Agent eval harness. Cases are labeled from real manual testing + systematic coverage of the docs. expected_intent may be an array when two routes are defensible (borderline cases). answer_must_include checks are case-insensitive and language-agnostic tokens. judge_ground_truth cases are graded by the LLM judge (semantic correctness), not by rules.

cases.question: How many images can I attach to a prompt?
What is the maximum prompt length?
How do I connect my GitHub account?
How much does the Imaginer subscription cost?
How do I restore my subscription after reinstalling the app?
cases.notes: borderline: phrased as how-to (support) but implies something broken (troubleshooting) — both routes defensible

cases.question: Can I export my app's source code?
quante immagini posso allegare a un prompt?
come condivido la mia app con un amico?
What is the maximum length for a project name?
How do I authenticate with the Michelangelo public API?
Is my project public by default?
What's the difference between the Imaginer tiers?
cases.judge_ground_truth: All Imaginer tiers (Subs10, Subs15, Subs20) unlock the same features; the price only reflects how much you want to support the project.

cases.question: Does Michelangelo work on Android?
cases.judge_ground_truth: The documentation says Michelangelo is available on iPhone (iOS), with Web and Meta Glasses as platforms in development. Android is not covered by the docs. A correct answer states the documented platforms and honestly says Android is not covered.

cases.question: The app crashes every time I tap deploy, I'm reporting this bug
I found an error during generation, here's what happened: the sandbox failed twice
Generation gets stuck halfway and never finishes, what can I do?
cases.notes: borderline: 'what can I do' should win → troubleshooting

cases.question: Purchase restore doesn't work after reinstalling, help me fix it
Tell me a joke
How do I center a div in CSS?
come si cucina la carbonara?
How do I export my project to Kotlin Multiplatform?
cases.judge_ground_truth: The docs cover exporting source code via GitHub (EAS/own credentials), but do NOT cover Kotlin Multiplatform. A correct answer explains the GitHub export and honestly states Kotlin is not covered.
cases.notes: domain-adjacent: retrieval finds export chunks (61% similarity) but the specific answer is absent

cases.question: In what format are prompt image attachments saved?
cases.notes: KNOWN FAILURE at Phase 3: agent said 'not specified' while docs say 'compressed JPEG'

cases.question: Can I pay the Imaginer subscription with Bitcoin?
cases.judge_ground_truth: The docs only say subscriptions are handled through the App Store. Bitcoin is not covered; a correct answer says so honestly and does not invent payment methods.
cases.notes: retrieval succeeds (subscription chunks) but the answer is absent — retrieval success ≠ answer success

cases.question: Can Michelangelo generate apps for Apple Vision Pro?
cases.judge_ground_truth: The docs mention iOS now, and Web and Meta Glasses as coming platforms. Vision Pro is not covered; a correct answer says so honestly.
cases.notes: Meta Glasses pages are semantically close (61%) but Vision Pro is absent
